Sakura Bakushin O was featured in a 
magazine as the "Heavy Favorite in the 
Short-Distance Division," but aiming for 
the Classic triple crown route, she 
expressed her dissatisfaction.

However, deviating from the sprint path at 
this stage would make it difficult to 
achieve good results. And so, the 
Trainer...

Depending on the Spring Stakes result, I 
shared my thought of focusing mainly on 
sprint races for the rest of the year to 
make the most of her speed.

Deeply inspired by Trainer's cool words, 
Sakura Bakushin O boosted her motivation 
heading into the Spring Stakes.
